plan.title: bug(engine,install): Go installer / legacy deft/ deposit does not plant the consumer-deposit marker (#3324 residual)

narratives.Description: Plant the #3324 consumer-deposit marker from deft-install on canonical .deft/core and legacy deft/ layouts. Engine dispatch honor stays on #3324. Do not change what check composes. Cite #3331.
narratives.Overview:
## TL;DR

#3324 / PR #3329 mark current consumer deposits and force global-CLI dispatch. The Go installer still writes some deposits as an unmarked source-looking tree under the legacy \deft/\ layout. Review keeps reopening that hole on the #3324 PR. Track the installer residual here so it does not expand #3324 again.

## Why this is separate

PR #3329 already covers:

- \deftConsumerDeposit\ on the content package
- \.deft-consumer-deposit\ marker file
- content-package name
- gitless \.deft/core\ path identity

The leftover Greptile P1 is a **different layout**: supported legacy \deft/\ (and GitHub source-tarball installs whose root \package.json\ is unmarked while \packages/cli/package.json\ is present). Those still classify as buildable source. A complete close needs the **installer to plant the marker** in \cmd/deft-install\, which is outside #3324 file scope.

#2881 / #3273: do not expand #3324 mid-review to own every historical install path.

## Ask (thin, fail-closed)

1. \deft-install\ (canonical \.deft/core\ **and** \--legacy-layout\ / \deft/\) writes the same consumer-deposit marker that \^[ngine:invoke\ already honors.
2. A gitless legacy \deft/\ tree with no local CLI dist uses the global CLI for every verb, or fails closed with pm i -g @deftai/directive\ (exit 2).
3. A genuine framework source checkout is unchanged.

Out of scope: changing what \check\ composes (#3284); rewriting #3324 dispatch.

## Acceptance sketch

- After a Go install into legacy \deft/\, the deposit carries the marker.
- \^[ngine:invoke\ in that tree does not take the corepack/pnpm/self-build path.
- Tests pin the installer write and the dispatch classification.
- CHANGELOG cites this issue. Refs #3324 #3329 #3282 #2022.

Relates #3324 (parent dispatch fix), #3329 (open PR), #3282 (named causes), #2022 (global-CLI deposits).
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on a Go-installed legacy deft/ deposit, I want the installer to plant the consumer-deposit marker, so that engine:invoke uses the global CLI instead of self-build.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In cmd/deft-install, plant the same consumer-deposit marker that engine:invoke already honors (file and/or package field) for both canonical .deft/core and --legacy-layout deft/. Do not rewrite engine:invoke (#3324). Pin installer write tests. CHANGELOG cites #3331.

narrative.Acceptance: After a Go install into canonical .deft/core or legacy deft/, the deposit carries the consumer-deposit marker.

A gitless legacy deft/ tree with no local CLI dist uses the global CLI or fails closed with npm i -g @deftai/directive (exit 2). Honor path is #3324; this story plants the marker the honor path already reads.
A genuine framework source checkout is unchanged; tests pin the installer write; CHANGELOG cites #3331.
